dedupe_keys.name: seismic resilience of urban networks dataset for infrastructure visualization and vulnerability assessment

description: Seismic resilience of urban networks: dataset for infrastructure visualization and vulnerability assessment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Marco Civera et al. We provide geographic information system (GIS) data and a multimodal dataset from a systematic infrastructure vulnerability assessment in the urban road networks of Turin and Naples, Italy. The seismic typologies of the relevant structural objects (SOs), including bridges, buildings, and roads, were evaluated using digital elevation models (DEMs) and satellite data. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2025. Formats: Excel, Shapefile, Image, PDF. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 22331619 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
